title: Classification of Elements
description: Periodic laws, table groupings, electron affinities, and atomic radii configurations.
key_points: Trends in physical properties (atomic size, ionization energy)
notes: The modern periodic table arranges elements by increasing atomic number. Periodic properties such as electronegativity and electron gain enthalpy trend periodically down groups and across periods.

practice_questions.question: Why does ionization enthalpy decrease down a group?
practice_questions.hint: Consider nuclear shielding and atomic size.
